question.problem:
Calculate $∇\times (F+2G)$ at the point $(1,1,1)$ for the vector fields $F$ and $G,$ where

$$
F(x,y,z)={x}^{2}z\,i+{x}^{2}y\,k,\,(∇\times G)(x,y,z)={x}^{2}z\,i+(xy-2xyz)\,j-xz\,k.
$$
question.worked_solution:
If $F$ and $G$ are vector fields and $k$ is a constant, then we have the following linearity properties for curl:

- $∇\times (kF)=k∇\times F$

- $∇\times (F+G)=∇\times F+∇\times G$

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\times (F+2G) & =∇\times F+∇\times (2G) \\  & =∇\times F+2∇\times G\end{aligned}
$$

First, we need to calculate $∇\times F.$ In doing so, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\times F & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ \frac{∂}{∂x} & \frac{∂}{∂y} & \frac{∂}{∂z} \\ {x}^{2}z & 0 & {x}^{2}y\end{aligned}| \\  & =[\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}y)-\frac{∂}{∂z}(0)]i-[\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}y)-\frac{∂}{∂z}({x}^{2}z)]j+[\frac{∂}{∂x}(0)-\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}z)]k \\  & =({x}^{2}-0)i-(2xy-{x}^{2})j+(0-0)k \\  & ={x}^{2}\,i+({x}^{2}-2xy)\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the linearity properties, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\times (F+2G) & =∇\times F+2∇\times G \\  & ={x}^{2}\,i+({x}^{2}-2xy)\,j+2[{x}^{2}z\,i+(xy-2xyz)\,j-xz\,k] \\  & =({x}^{2}+2{x}^{2}z)\,i+({x}^{2}-2xy+2xy-4xyz)\,j-2xz\,k \\  & ={x}^{2}(1+2z)\,i+({x}^{2}-4xyz)\,j-2xz\,k.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, evaluating at the point $(1,1,1),$ we get

$$
(∇\times (F+2G))(1,1,1)=3\,i-3\,j-2\,k.
$$
